newsitem.title: USA: Pool Energy Services signs merger letter.
newsitem.headline: Pool Energy Services signs merger letter.

text.p: Pool Energy Services Co said on Monday that it has signed a letter of intent to acquire privately owned D A & S Oil Well Servicing Inc.

Pool Energy did not disclose terms of the deal, but company chairman and chief executive Jim Jongebloed said the acquisition "is expected to add annual revenues of approximately $12 million, based upon current activity levels.
"The purchase of D A & S is an important step in our ongoing efforts to seek expansion opportunities in the company's core market areas," he added.
The company anticipated that the transaction will close in June.
Pool Energy is an energy services company principally engaged in providing well-servicing, workover and drilling services on land and offshore.
D A & S operates a fleet of 37 land well-servicing rigs from yards in Hobbs and Eunice, New Mexico, and Andrews, Texas.
